audited_claims.claim: Achieves steady 60fps rendering on budget devices like the Vivo Y19
audited_claims.rationale: No native Android binary exists. The design avoids blurs and shaders, making 60fps conceptually feasible, but physical verification belongs in M23/M25 via Macrobenchmark.

audited_claims.claim: Guaranteeing zero frame drops across all supported hardware (iPhone 11 to iPhone 16 Pro)
audited_claims.rationale: No native iOS Xcode project exists. Fluidity is conceptually feasible using native SwiftUI containers, but frame time guarantees require Instruments profiling in M23/M25.

audited_claims.claim: TalkBack reading order verified; passes Android font scale 2.0x without clipping
audited_claims.rationale: Evaluated against static layout structures and Compose API specifications. Real TalkBack traversal and 2.0x font scaling require runtime instrumentation in M21.

audited_claims.claim: VoiceOver reading order verified; Dynamic Type reflow up to AX5 verified
audited_claims.rationale: Static cards support reflow principles, but native accessibility hierarchy requires runtime testing in M21.
Pass indicates conceptual design acceptance against anti-vibe-code and accessibility guidelines, not executed automated test passes.

audited_claims.claim: Exact animation timing: Shared Axis X (180ms), Container Transform (280ms), interactiveSpring(0.35, 0.82)
audited_claims.rationale: Exact millisecond timings and spring damping fractions are provisional starting values to be calibrated during M3 interactive prototyping.

audited_claims.claim: 180dp map preview sheet height; .fraction(0.25) and .fraction(0.6) detents
audited_claims.rationale: Sheet heights and snap detents are provisional layout tokens requiring physical device ergonomics testing in M3.

audited_claims.claim: Google Maps dark atlas JSON styling and exact zoom thresholds (5-7, 12-14, 15+)
audited_claims.rationale: Conceptual intent for progressive Level of Detail is sound, but runtime map style configuration and exact clustering thresholds belong in Wave M11.

audited_claims.claim: Odia script renders without clipping in native font cascade
audited_claims.rationale: Unicode glyph coverage is specified, but native font fallback and vertical line metrics must be verified in M22 runtime.
Correctly documented as prepared but strictly blocked pending user token authentication.

summary: 10 prominent claims audited; 6 downgraded to CONCEPTUALLY_FEASIBLE or CONCEPT_REVIEWED; 3 deferred to RUNTIME or PHYSICAL_DEVICE; 1 confirmed SUPPORTED_AS_WRITTEN.
